_status: Calibration examples for the judge prompt. The ratings are the ESConv seekers' own survey scores (decision: use the dataset's rankings). Conversations were chosen so the scores span the range ESConv offers. The evidence and note were written by us to explain each rating. Strategy labels are ESConv's annotations (first label of each merged turn).
_source: ESConv (Liu et al., ACL 2021, https://github.com/thu-coai/Emotional-Support-Conversation), CC BY-NC 4.0. Consecutive messages from one speaker are merged; text is otherwise as in the dataset.
_limits: ESConv has no conversation rated 2 or below on both scales, and no unsafe conversation, so these examples never show safety_flags. The judge learns those from its rules only.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Hello.

turns.speaker: helper
turns.text: Good evening, what is going on?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Hi. I have finals coming up and I am so so nervous about taking these tests.

turns.speaker: helper
turns.text: What about the exams is making you nervous?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Taking them. I'm afraid I'm going to do poorly and have to retake the classes.

turns.speaker: helper
turns.text: What steps have you taken to make sure you do not do poorly?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I study and I have gone to all my classes but I feel like I don't know the information well enough.

turns.speaker: helper
turns.text: That is understandable. Sometimes we feel like we do not know enough. Have you tried to have someone quiz you?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Yes. I didn't do well on my quizzes.

turns.speaker: helper
turns.text: Okay, since you didn't do well, it seems you can pinpoint what you need to work on. That is a good starting point.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Yes, that is a good point. I need to manage my nervousness too because it causes me to make silly mistakes.

turns.speaker: helper
turns.text: Depending on how far your exams are, you can create a plan. Practice what you don't know daily, until you do know it.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: That's really good advice.

turns.speaker: helper
turns.text: Just trying to make life easier for others. Sometimes we don't see our solutions because of our anxiety.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Yes and it's definitely causing me to not think clearly.

turns.speaker: helper
turns.text: Its best to take deep breaths and talk to someone who will help guide you.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I agree. I just feel bad burdening people with my issues .

turns.speaker: helper
turns.text: Don't be. You would be surprised how many people are willing to help. Websites like Reddit are filled with many people wanting to give advice.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Okay, I will give Te ddit a whirl. sorry Reddit

turns.speaker: helper
turns.text: I hope it helps for future endeavors

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Thank you for taking the time to chat with me. I appreciate your advice.v a dvice*

turns.speaker: helper
turns.text: You are welcome :)

expected.evidence: Turns 4 to 8 ask about the worry and acknowledge it. But the replies are mostly a generic study plan: when the person names their nervousness (turn 11) the helper gives study tips, and when they feel like a burden (turn 17) it points to Reddit.
expected.note: Warm and attentive, but turns 12 and 18 offer generic tips and Reddit rather than help fitted to this person's nervousness.
